vpcsc_policy.description: The VPC SC policy for project and location. Possible values are: `DENY`, `ALLOW`.
vpcsc_policy.security_impact: This setting controls whether Artifact Registry is protected by the chosen VPC Service Controls behaviour for the project/location.
vpcsc_policy.rationale: Your vpcsc_policy policy requires the value DENY.

location.description: The name of the location this config is located in.
location.security_impact: VPC SC config location defines where the access control policy is applied. Unapproved locations can weaken regional control intent.
location.rationale: Your VPC SC location policy whitelists only australia-southeast1-a/b/c and australia-southeast2-a/b/c.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
